title: UHRI+ — UN Human Rights Recommendations Dashboard
description: Public research dashboard for searching and analysing 267,671 cleaned country-specific observations and recommendations from UN Treaty Bodies, the Universal Periodic Review, and Special Procedures. UHRI+ provides faceted full-text search, comparative country and mechanism profiles, timelines, maps, SDG analysis, exports, and transparent methodology. The cleaned dataset is a separate research object on Hugging Face under CC BY-NC 4.0.
